sample_unit: patient FAQs (each answered by two ChatGPT versions, rated by three surgeons)

links.outcome: Clinician-rated accuracy of LLM answers to patient questions
links.effect: Median accuracy scores 2 (range 1-3) for ChatGPT-3.5 and 1.5 (range 1-3) for ChatGPT-4; 25% and 50% rated excellent; none rated unsatisfactory requiring substantial clarification.
links.quote: The median ratings for responses ranged from "excellent not requiring clarification" to "satisfactory requiring moderate clarification."

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy of ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 answering patient FAQs about femoroacetabular impingement syndrome, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
